data.content_ref: inline:The problem 061ddfcce3bb reduces to SRC_001's 'transfer of intelligence' hypothesis, proposing that the difference between compliance and reliability is the difference between executing a transferred heuristic (compliance) and possessing the meta-expertise to validate that heuristic (reliability). This relation is refuted if the panel can achieve 'genuine reliability' without any transfer of intelligence from a meta-expert author.
